RegistrationInfo.Description: CI Watchdog (item 204). Every 2 min: poll GitHub Actions for a failed main run, run a tool-restricted headless claude on the dedicated CI-watchdog worktree to produce a minimal lint/compile/import/single-test fix, open a ci-fix PR, BLOCK on that PR's own CI and squash-merge it only when green (self-gated; no branch protection needed), cancel a fix whose target run is stale (main moved on), and escalate to a local ESCALATION.md after two strikes or if a fix's CI stays red. Kill-switch: ops\runtime\ci_watchdog\HALT. Runs as the logged-on operator account so gh/claude/git auth resolves (NOT SYSTEM). See tools/ci_watchdog.py + docs/CI_WATCHDOG_PLAN.md.
